question: What incapacitating effect on speech can be produced through this power?
premises: The power can destroy wind and related faculties.
The affected person remains like a mute.
inference: By destroying the power of wind and such, one can render another mute in speech.
uncertainties: The agent of nāśayet is implicit from context.
plain_english: One can destroy the power of wind and so forth, so that he stands mute in speech.
